Verdict: ACCEPT the synthetic design contract at `4fed9eb3a666c9ab368c488d0e6b391c6285c45b` (iter/0050/312), for Policymaker consideration for baseline evidence pinning.
Actual model family: OpenAI GPT-6/Codex; recorded review actions used gpt-6.1-sol, the author's family. No cross-family independence is claimed.
Reviewed saved candidate files read-only from main; no repository files changed. Both required SHA256 values match; see [scope and coverage](artifacts/review-318-coverage.md).

## Standards
1. Blocking: no. No documented standards violations found in the three-file change; synthetic provenance and unresolved decisions are explicit (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:2`, `benchmark/baseline/run-record.template.json:175`).

## Spec
2. Blocking: no. Frozen fields cover the assigned case/arm/repetition, manifest/prompt hashes, accounting, truncation/exhaustion and claim-pointer requirements (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:19`). Missing fields: none for this scope; each additional field is named in the [coverage evidence](artifacts/review-318-coverage.md).
3. Blocking: no. Conversion matches score.py's claim inputs and preserves duplicates, order, conditions and citations; only the two templates are read, without expected-answer access (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:93`, `benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:206`; `benchmark/scripts/score.py:127`). [Compatibility evidence](artifacts/review-318-compatibility.json).
4. Blocking: no for design acceptance. Manifest-content binding remains explicitly unresolved (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:134`; `benchmark/baseline/run-record.template.json:203`). Require actual binding and a negative test before production runner integration.
5. Blocking: no. All 35 populated fields are synthetic-marked; eight unresolved fields are null with reasons. Nested call-error null denotes no synthetic error. No real answers/private data found; output reports design only, zero runs, no readiness and unmeasured tool quality (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py:244`).

Verification: candidate --check passed in an external temporary copy; three independent source mutations each caused --check to fail. Required `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` passed: 33/33 controls, three fixtures, zero mismatches. [Exact outputs](artifacts/review-318-checks.json).
Next: Policymaker may pin the reviewed design and commission remaining production prerequisites. This review establishes neither benchmark readiness nor approval of runs, quality thresholds or evaluator changes.
